Header: Sclerotinia sclerotiorum Sinhala- Sudupus rogaya; Tamil- Venpakaupoonchanam

Prevention: Select fields free form disease history
Remove and destroy crop residues before land preparation
Deep plough the field and expose to sunlight for 2 weeks
Apply lime (2 t/ha) two weeks before planting to increase soil pH Maintain the proper spacing (60 x 45 cm)
Apply water in the morning to allow sufficient time for leaves to dry
Monitoring: Look for water soaked lesions on leaves and crown
Observe fluffy mass of white mycelia on infected areas, Black sclerotia can be observed on the soil surface of stem base during cool and wet conditions (below 18ºC)
Direct Control: Remove infected plants with surrounding soil
Restrictions: Use protective clothing when applying pesticides
Do not eat or drink while using pesticides and take suitable precautions when disposing of materials
SC) 10 ml/10 l at the onset of disease
